title: ProjectLease
description: The single owner of a project's runtime at one fencing epoch. The database holds the authoritative row; this schema is the API/contract projection.

project_id.description: Stable RAVEL project id; never supplied by a model as trusted identity.

owner_instance_id.description: Runtime instance that owns the lease. A new owner must atomically increment epoch.

epoch.description: Fencing token. Starts at 1; takeover increments it; old bindings never upgrade.

expires_at.description: UTC RFC3339 expiry. Database time is authoritative.
